title: Smart Data Models - AGROVOC - ConceptScheme
description: A set of concepts, optionally including statements about semantic relationships between them (skos:ConceptScheme). Here, the AGROVOC thesaurus itself and its top concepts. Attributes are the properties actually used on AGROVOC concept schemes in release 2026-11-05 (counted on the AGROVOC SPARQL endpoint), named exactly as in SKOS, SKOS-XL, DCMI and the Agrontology.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ConceptScheme:<AGROVOC local id> (e.g. c_8373, xl_en_1299522993458, agrovoc).

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ConceptScheme'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp (NGSI-LD system attribute; the source's own dct:created is 'created').

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification (NGSI-LD system attribute; the source's own dct:modified is 'modified').

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

sameAs.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs'. Not an AGROVOC statement (Smart Data Models addition): the canonical AGROVOC IRI of this resource (http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrovoc/<local id>), which the NGSI-LD entity id is derived from.

hasTopConcept.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#hasTopConcept'. Relates a concept scheme to a concept that is topmost in the broader/narrower hierarchy of that scheme. Used 25 times on 1 AGROVOC concept schemes (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Concept entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Concept:c_<code>).

modified.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.org/dc/terms/modified'. Date on which the resource was last changed (xsd:dateTime as published; some values have no timezone). Used 1 times on 1 AGROVOC concept schemes (release 2026-11-05).

prefLabel.description: Property. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#prefLabel'. The preferred lexical label for a resource, in a given language. Used 1 times on 1 AGROVOC concept schemes (release 2026-11-05). Language map: one string per BCP 47 language tag (can be exchanged as an NGSI-LD LanguageProperty).

skosxl:prefLabel.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2008/05/skos-xl#prefLabel'. The preferred label of the concept, as a reified skosxl:Label resource (one per language). Used 1 times on 1 AGROVOC concept schemes (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).
